Maya Chen: Quick heads-up team — VIP customer AureliaHealth is doing a rehearsal tomorrow 02:00 UTC for their enterprise rollout. We're expecting a short spike (est ~3k rps for ~10m) and heavier-than-normal long-context requests (avg seq ~3k tokens). Known risk: KV cache growth + large batches caused OOM on older GPU profiles in last sim. Please read the checklist below and ack coverage swaps.

Maya Chen: Hot points:
- Canary route: `vip/aurelia/rehearsal` (do not change model version unless coordinated)
- Risk nodes: ded-1-smallgpu (older memory profile) — if we see >85% mem use, trigger fallback
- SLA: contract requires 99.9% p99 latency under agreed capacity; we need to avoid mass timeouts

Maya Chen: Quick mitigation plan (short):
```
# temporary canary tweak
batching.max_tokens: 1500
batching.max_batch_size: 4
fallback.model: aurelia-quant-small-v2
```

Maya Chen: Coverage ask: I can cover 01:30-03:30 UTC. Need someone to take 03:30-05:30 UTC. Also need a code-review on the canary tweak PR before 00:45 UTC. @omar @luis please ping if you can take oncall swap or CR. :eyes:

Omar Patel: taking 03:30-05:30 UTC. I can also push the small-batch canary and monitor memory. I'll run the reduced batch canary and keep logs streaming to #eng-sre.

Omar Patel: plan to run: `/deploy canary --route vip/aurelia/rehearsal --set batching.max_batch_size=4` — will monitor `node_mem` and `kv_cache_size`. If mem>85% for 2 consecutive mins I'll roll back to fallback model.

Luis Rivera: I can do the PR CR before 00:40 UTC. I'll also add a short rollback script and a quick health-check that queries p99 for 5m windows and posts to the watch channel. PR here: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321

Luis Rivera: Also recommending we pre-pin a fallback variant `aurelia-quant-small-v2` on the route so fallback is instant (no cold-start). I can coordinate with infra to stage that by 23:30 UTC tonight.

Maya Chen: perfect — @Omar please add your exact pager number in the handoff note. @Luis please add the fallback pin action to the rollout checklist. I'll fold both into the runbook entry `/runbooks/vip-aurelia-watch.md` and send the final handoff at 01:15 UTC.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled — Handoff reminder at 01:15 UTC (2073459300). React with :thumbsup: to confirm you saw this.

Omar Patel: :thumbsup: confirmed. I'll post live mem metrics link in channel at 02:00 UTC.

Luis Rivera: :thumbsup: I'll drop the rollback script and the health-check dashboard link by 00:30 UTC.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — logging this as the official watch thread. If anything changes ping here and escalate to eng-sre immediately. :rocket:
